<function name="AddSoundOverrides" parent="sound" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Overrides [sound scripts](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Soundscripts) defined inside of a `.txt` file; typically used for adding map-specific sounds.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="filepath" type="string">Path to the script file to load.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Adds and overrides all sounds defined in scripts/override_test.txt</description>
	<code>sound.AddSoundOverrides("scripts/override_test.txt")</code>
	<output>
```
SoundEmitter:  adding map sound overrides from scripts/override_test.txt [1 total, 1 replacements, 0 duplicated replacements]
```

(Displayed in the console)
	</output>

</example>
